# Kenney Fantasy Town Kit 2.0 — curated subset

- Author: Kenney
- Official page: https://kenney.nl/assets/fantasy-town-kit
- Downloaded: 2026-10-26
- License: Creative Commons CC0 1.0; the original `LICENSE.txt` is stored beside this file.
- Original package: `kenney_fantasy-town-kit_2.0.zip`

Only the modular pieces used or evaluated for Michael Island were imported. The rest of the 160-file pack was intentionally omitted to keep the Unity project, Git LFS checkout, and Quest build small.

The selected FBX models provide authored arches, windows, tower roof pieces, stone stairs, balcony railings, lanterns, fountain pieces, and floating-island rock dressing. The unique triangular platform, rune paths, and gameplay colliders remain project-authored structural geometry.
